column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3 Kederon residents, clinic, and shop interactions
# Selector-audited field NPC banks; no manual wrapping.

column2: No village is safer than this one...
Why, since its founding, it has never once been caught up in a war!
Every resident here is someone who made a name for themselves and proved their strength in some other town...
In that sense, this village's people are descendants of the truly chosen strong, you might say...
I'm bored... So terribly bored...
Work?! That's for young people and $$奴隷$$s!
We just work hard so we can spend every day in $$怠惰$$!
Which is exactly why we're so terribly bored!
As if it weren't bad enough that children keep dwindling because of disease and war...
Hearing this village was unlikely to be caught up in war, wealthy old people came from all over the $$世界$$.
Thanks to that, nearly ninety percent of this village is now old folk...
What do you lot want?!
Fine young people like you, loafing about in broad daylight instead of working...!!
Work yourselves to death so us old folk can live lives of $$怠惰$$!!
Hey...
Think it'd be wrong if I cut this old geezer down...?
The price of gravestones around this village has risen steeply lately... It's a real problem.
And it isn't as though there has been a war or an outbreak of disease...
This village's medical care is the best in the $$世界$$!
Drawn in by all the old folks coming from across the continent...
countless $$医者$$s bent on $$強欲$$ have gathered here too...!!
But don't worry: the young people pay all this village's medical costs...
so we old folk get it all free!
At the edge of this village, for young people and $$奴隷$$s who cannot pay their $$年貢$$...
there lives an odd fellow who runs a free clinic...
Because of that, the other $$医者$$s apparently harass him terribly all the time...
Well, only to be expected, I suppose!
Gaaahhh!
Damn it!!
Who could live in a village with $$年貢$$ this high?!
Hey! You lot shouldn't stay in a place like this long...!!
They take almost eighty percent of your income for the old folks' hospital bills...
Please don't talk to me right now...
In this village, whenever a child is born, they collect the same $$年貢$$ from that child as from an adult...
So the more children you have, the poorer and poorer you become...
I'm seriously wondering whether I should give birth to this child...
All the young people have left this village behind!
Lucky black $$羽$$...
Me? I'm a $$奴隷$$. There's no way I could run away...
The old people in this village...
are always grumbling, "I'm bored, I'm bored"...
but not one of them will work!
Welcome—oh! I haven't had a young customer in ages...
What could you possibly want!?
